title: Your First Mini-Project
concept: Combine everything you've learned into one complete program that uses multiple data types, calculations, and output.
why: Real programs combine all the building blocks. This project helps you see how types, variables, math, and output work together.
syntax_ref:
// Your toolkit so far:
let x = 42;              // Immutable variable
var y = 0;               // Mutable variable
io.println("text");      // Output
+ - * / %                // Math
== != < > <= >=          // Comparisons
&& || !                  // Logic
as Float64, as Int       // Conversions
tips: Break big problems into small steps — one variable at a time
Test your program mentally before running: what should the result be?
Celebrate! You've learned the foundations of programming
common_mistakes: Trying to do everything in one line — use intermediate variables
Mixing Int and Float64 without converting
Forgetting to import `use xiom.string;` for format functions
